source: deterministic report-only replay of saved A/B seeds; no real bars/outcomes

noEdgeLambda.method: For each strategy-card × claim-half × verdict-state cell in A, estimate the net-gate probability under zero gross edge and true cost-adjusted signed mean, using observed n, SD and CR1 calendar-day SE; multiply by the Gaussian one-sided excess-gate probability at t>2, and sum. Concentration/LOYO vetoes are omitted, so this is an upper-bound approximation. Card probability combines two half-cell probabilities as independent; Poisson approximation is applied to unique card confirmations.

diagnosticNotes.lambdaScope: noEdgeLambda is estimated from condition A only and is the Part 1 criterion-relevant null model. A prior A+B-pooled exploratory estimate is omitted because B is not the zero-drift no-edge generator.
diagnosticNotes.rangeLabel: Historical meanRange output is actually meanAbsBarDelta (mean absolute close-open change); do not interpret as high-low range.
diagnosticNotes.calibration: Condition B drift calibrator mismatch documented in docs/G0-AMENDMENT-8B-PART1-DIAGNOSIS.md.
